test_item_verbatim: The Head Unit shall gate FD-CAN8 EPS_FD_1.LwsAngle to LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.LwsAngle

tcs.tc_title: gate LwsAngle to LwsAngle, set the CAN signal and read vehicleUpdate_2.LwsAngle
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. A bus analyzer is connected to the LVDS link between the HU and the RVCM
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: EPS_FD_1.LwsAngle = 7200 (0.0 degrees)
2. Read vehicleUpdate_2.LwsAngle and check that it reports the value sent in step 1
tcs.expected_result:
1. EPS_FD_1.LwsAngle = 7200 (0.0 degrees) is sent
2. vehicleUpdate_2.LwsAngle reports the same value and is sent over LVDS
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.test_item:
The Head Unit shall gate FD-CAN8 EPS_FD_1.LwsAngle to LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.LwsAngle

(gate LwsAngle to LwsAngle, set the CAN signal and read vehicleUpdate_2.LwsAngle)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 `SYS-RA-VF551_V2-745`（`VF551_V2_PDT27` 前綴）之 DT27 分支。**訊號實測可書寫**：`EPS_FD_1`（`BO_ 264`，FDCAN8）之 `SG_ LwsAngle : 7|16@0+ (0.1,-720) [-720|720] "°"` —— raw 7200 = 0.0 度。與 `-152`（HDCC27，`STEERING1`）為同一 LVDS 標的之兩個平台來源，訊息名相異故拆列。LVDS 訊號無 DBC（四本零命中），其值以來源 label 逐字書寫、觀察以 bus analyzer 進行，**不造命令**（profile §7.2／§7.3）。
